title: ロボット設計演習Ⅱ
subtitle: Engineering Exercise for Robotics II
teachers:
FUJIKI Nobuaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn mechanical design skills.
(2) Learn mechanical drawing skills.
(3) Learn how to use mechanical elements.
advice:
This is a practical course on the design of a reduction gear. We will cover the following topics:

1. Design of spur gear
2. Design of input and output shafts
3. Bearing selection
4. 3D-CAD mechanical drawing
books:
Textbooks: Methods of Machine Design, Morikita Publishing (in Japanese), Practice of Mechanical Design and Drafting, Suurikougakusha Co.,Ltd.(in Japanese), New JIS Mechanical Drawing, Morikita Publishing (in Japanese)
Reference books: None
Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge:
Completion of Industrial Mechanics and Material Mechanics
Basic knowledge of mechanical drawing

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the implementation of mechanical design, and use 3D-CAD drawings to explain design images.
Be able to carry out design calculations, such as basic design and detailed design of components.
Be able to create 3D-CAD machine designs that consider manufacturing methods, according to the machine drafting.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)Understand the substance and shape of the design according to the instructions and prepare an easy-to-read assembly drawing by applying it to your own design conditions.
(2)Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions.
(3) Perform drawing of a 3D-CAD model of lower casing in addition to a 3D-CAD assembly model consisting of axes,gears,bearing and collar.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)Understand the content and shape of the design according to the instructions.
(2)Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions.
(3)Perform drawing of a 3D-CAD assembly model consisting of axes,gears,bearing and collar.
